rows.quirks: Inherits the session model; the skill body fills session_model on every request (the id its harness reports) so the floor check has its input and the sidecar's effective_model names the real id. Host lane (Slice C): starved, packet-only, and any pinned effort run through the Workflow route (assets/claude-boxes.workflow.js filled by `readers compose`; the run record's per-agent toolCalls goes to `readers record --tool-calls`); repo and repo-with-tools with no effort run as a general-purpose subagent through the Agent tool, in worktree isolation when the request says so. Isolation measured 2026-09-06 (docs/evidence/readers/slice-c-host-runs.md): starved and packet-only reads through the Workflow route returned with tool_uses 0 and the decoy read (AC5) quoted no file, reported no decoy line, and named no earlier finding; repo and repo-with-tools are instruction-bound and stay unmeasured.
